description: Inputs that MUST be rejected by canonicalization. A conforming implementation MUST throw/error for each of these.

vectors.note: NaN cannot be represented in JSON. Implementations must test this in-language.
Infinity cannot be represented in JSON. Implementations must test this in-language.
-Infinity cannot be represented in JSON. Implementations must test this in-language.

vectors.description: integer above MAX_SAFE_INTEGER MUST be rejected
integer below MIN_SAFE_INTEGER MUST be rejected
deeply nested object exceeding depth 128 MUST be rejected
vectors.note: Generate a 129-level nested object programmatically. Cannot represent in JSON vector file.

vectors.description: cyclic object reference MUST be rejected
vectors.note: A cyclic reference (obj.self = obj) cannot be represented in JSON. Implementations must test this in-language.
BigInt is a language-native type in JavaScript and cannot be represented in JSON. Implementations must test this in-language. Example: canonicalize(BigInt(1)) must throw.
Symbol is a language-native type in JavaScript and cannot be represented in JSON. Implementations must test this in-language. Example: canonicalize(Symbol('x')) must throw.
